importantFindings.finding: The original 67 was attributed as 66 on the earlier crop. Five supplied originals now show 16 to 24 fewer flags each under telephone-off, automatic name order and age/date corroboration. The threshold remains 70.

Telephone-off suppresses reporting, display, counting and storage. The phone-shaped pattern still helps find the table boundary and retain faint rows; disabling that structural signal damaged names and dates.
Row fragmentation remains the largest residual cause. It was measured but not fixed because the owner explicitly deferred S4.
